notes.title: Special holiday event
notes.content:
A special event will take place from December 24, 2022 at 00:00 Paris time to December 31, 2022 at 00:00 Paris time

This event will take place in Albania the frozen land, a brand new non-player character will be present, just talk to him 
to start the special event and get some
unique items.
All the team RABAH CHIKHI wishes you 
happy holidays
